evals.prompt:
This VB.NET console tool worked on old DraftSight but our team's version check says it uses deprecated stuff. Can you fix it so it's correct for DraftSight 2026 and still runs on 2018 SP2? Here it is:

Imports DraftSight.Interop.dsAutomation
Imports System.Runtime.InteropServices
Module Module1
    Sub Main()
        Dim dsApp As Application = CType(Marshal.GetActiveObject("DraftSight.Application"), Application)
        Dim dsDoc As Document = dsApp.OpenDocument("C:\work\plan.dwg", dsDocumentOpenOption_e.dsDocumentOpen_Default)
        Dim sheets As Object() = CType(dsDoc.GetSheets(), Object())
        For i As Integer = 1 To sheets.Length - 1
            Dim s As Sheet = CType(sheets(i), Sheet)
            Dim sk As SketchManager = s.GetSketchManager()
            sk.InsertBlock("TITLE", 0, 0, 0, 1, 0)
        Next
        Dim err As dsDocumentSaveError_e
        dsDoc.SaveAs("C:\work\plan_out.dwg", dsDocumentSaveAsOption_e.dsDocumentSaveAs_R2018_DWG, err)
        dsDoc.GetDocumentExporter().ExportToPdf("C:\work\plan.pdf", Nothing, 420, 297, Nothing)
    End Sub
End Module
evals.expected_output: Corrected VB.NET module that replaces OpenDocument with OpenDocument2 (dsEncoding_Default), GetSheets with GetSheets2 and a loop starting at index 0 because GetSheets2 excludes the model, InsertBlock with InsertBlock2 and separate scales, SaveAs with SaveAs2 and an Overwrite argument, ExportToPdf with CreateExportSettings plus ExportToPdf2 (2018), keeps every member at or below 2018 SP2, adds AbortRunningCommand and null checks, and reports the check results.
expectations: Replaces OpenDocument with OpenDocument2 including a dsEncoding_e argument
Replaces GetSheets with GetSheets2 and changes the loop to start at index 0 (or explains that GetSheets2 no longer returns the model first)
Replaces InsertBlock with InsertBlock2 and SaveAs with SaveAs2
Replaces ExportToPdf with CreateExportSettings and ExportToPdf2, which is available since 2018
Uses no member whose since is later than 2018 SP2 (for example no RunCommand2 or CopyEntities2)
Adds null checks for the opened document and decodes or checks the save error value
Transcript shows swapi.py check run on the fixed code with --target 2018 SP2 or equivalent
